summary: NIFTY at LTP and at Quote, its streaming id (-23) looked up over REST as it is first subscribed: an index quote frame, then a partial one with a new price and change; that tick carries Samco's ltq, sent under last_quantity and last_trade_quantity, while the first quote, without one, sends neither.

notes: Indices subscribe by Samco's listingId with no segment suffix (samcoWebSocket.py subscribe). The feed looks it up over REST when the first client subscribes (Broker::feed_presubscribe, audit RB-05); the web glue answers _get_index_listing_id with the same id.

deviations.reason: For an index the web sends a best bid and ask of 0 that Samco never sent (an index has no book; the frame has no bPr/aPr); the desktop leaves them out.
